articles.image_title: LA LINEA DE LA CONCEPCION - JULY 15: People wait to cross the border into Gibraltar under the new Spain-Gibraltar border agreement on July 15, 2026 in La Linea de la Concepción, Spain. The 118-year-old physical border fence and land checkpoints separating Gibraltar and the Spanish border town of La Línea de la Concepción are being completely removed. This will end routine passport and customs checks at the land frontier as part of a post-Brexit treaty integrating Gibraltar into the EU's Schengen free-travel zone and customs union.
